channel.title: CleanBit Mac Storage Guides

item.title: Is Xcode DerivedData Safe to Delete? What Happens and How to Clean It
item.description: Yes, Xcode DerivedData is safe to delete. Learn what lives inside DerivedData, what actually happens after removing it, and how to clean Xcode caches safely.

item.title: How to Find and Delete Old node_modules Folders on a Mac
item.description: Measure how much space old node_modules folders take on macOS, remove them safely from Terminal, and avoid breaking active or pnpm projects.

item.title: Claude Code, Cursor and Codex Eating Disk Space on Your Mac? Here's Where It Goes
item.description: Find out why Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex consume gigabytes on macOS. Includes real developer Mac measurements, read-only audit commands, and safe cleanup steps.
